lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: River's dropped near two feet since the council fire. Sandbars everywhere — the boats will earn their keep.

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: Put it in the log, Captain. Every sounding is a line on the map someone will follow.

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: A whole village of barking squirrels! Stand still — the President must have one of these alive.

discovery.text: Discovery: the prairie dog. A burrowing squirrel that whistles an alarm from its mound. Lewis resolves to send one east.

lines.speaker: Drouillard
lines.text: Fresh elk sign, Captain. Big herd, not an hour ahead — they're making for the draw.

encounter.text: Drouillard brings down an elk. Fresh meat tonight. (+12 food)

lines.speaker: York
lines.text: Sky's gone the color of a bruise. That one's coming straight for us.

lines.speaker: York
lines.text: Well — river wanted a drink anyhow.

lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: Smoke on that ridge to the west. Someone's letting us know they see us.

scenario_hook.text: Otoe and Missouria messengers point the way to the bluff where the council will meet. (Placeholder — Scenario and cultural review pending.)

lines.speaker: Sgt. Floyd
lines.text: Begging your pardon, Captain — it's only a pain in my side. It'll pass by morning.

lines.speaker: Clark
lines.text: Keep him close to the fire tonight, York.
